PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python - <<'PY_METRIC'
import csv, json
from pathlib import Path
q = Path('/home/xu/project/loop/DeepScientist/quests/001')
meta = json.loads((q/'experiments/stage10/08_meta/STAGE10_META_ANALYSIS.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
large = json.loads((q/'experiments/stage10/07_large_eval/LARGE_EVAL_SUMMARY.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
with (q/'experiments/stage10/08_meta/SELECTOR_METRICS.csv').open(newline='', encoding='utf-8') as f:
    rows = list(csv.DictReader(f))
by_selector = {r['selector_name']: r for r in rows}
selector_summary = {}
for name in ['OrbitRepair-Proxy', 'LoopCert-only', 'family-balanced blend', 'risk-calibrated blend', 'Pareto-front', 'CFC-only']:
    r = by_selector[name]
    selector_summary[name] = {
        'regret_at3': float(r['macro_normalized_regret_at3']),
        'mean_cost_to_contain_winner': float(r['mean_cost_to_contain_winner']),
        'beats_cfc_regret_at3': r['beats_cfc_only_on_macro_normalized_regret_at3'] == 'True',
        'beats_cfc_cost': r['beats_cfc_only_on_mean_cost_to_contain_winner'] == 'True',
        'top3_containments': int(r['top3_containments']),
        'model_count': int(r['model_count']),
    }
out = {
    'large_eval_gate_passed': meta['gate_results']['large_eval_gate_passed'],
    'seed_robustness_gate_passed': meta['gate_results']['seed_robustness_gate_passed'],
    'ce_selection_gate_passed': meta['gate_results']['ce_selection_gate_passed'],
    'closed_reasons': meta['gate_results']['closed_reasons'],
    'evaluated_endpoint_rows': large['evaluated_endpoint_rows'],
    'expected_formal_endpoint_rows': large['expected_formal_endpoint_rows'],
    'total_table_rows_including_original': large['total_table_rows_including_original'],
    'seed_robustness_rows_total': sum(v['row_count'] for v in meta['seed_robustness_summary']['by_budget'].values()),
    'selector_summary': selector_summary,
}
print(json.dumps(out, sort_keys=True))
PY_METRIC
